title: COLMAP
description: COLMAP — Reality-to-Simulation Reconstruction Engine (public edition). Real documented tool; god-mode caveat applies.
body: COLMAP is a real, publicly documented software tool relevant to Reality-to-Simulation Reconstruction Engine. Open-source structure-from-motion and multi-view stereo pipeline from ETH Zurich. In the context of the god-mode vision, it represents the current real-world state of the art for part of what "Reality-to-Simulation Reconstruction Engine" aspires to do: Builds approximate virtual scenes from supported imagery, sensor data, and measurements.. Its documented capabilities include scenario modeling and physics coupling, and it is used in production or research settings today.
